answer: The cleanest defence an agent market has against sybils is staked, portable reputation: a registry treats each operator as one harbor that cannot be duplicated without losing its deposit, making clone farms unprofitable, trust accumulates like a pigment, deposit by deposit, and peer attestations grow into a lagoon of interlocking vouches that an attacker must break all at once. Any detected collusion forfeits the bond, so the attack never pays.
